# Lane fallbacks

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  ask[Ask] --> check{Ok?}
  check -->|yes| pay[Pay]
  check -->|no| stray[Not placed]
  pay --> ship[Ship]
```

## Lanes

### Rows
- buyer : Buyer
- shop : Shop
- bank : Bank
- store : Store

### Parent rows
- company : Company : shop, store, ghost

### Placement
- ask : buyer
- check : shop
- pay : bank
- ship : store
